findings.rationale: The jump security group allows administrative SSH from the entire internet by setting the ingress CIDR to 0.0.0.0/0 on TCP 22.
The escalation role is directly assumable and has a policy attachment that makes the privileged identity available to the jump host.
The connectivity graph connects the internet-exposed jump security group to the escalation role through an STS assume-role edge, enabling a direct pivot from network ingress to privileged identity.
The wildcard identity policy in the open IAM fixture reaches the S3 public-read bucket, so the broad identity grant compounds into data exposure.
